lines.text: One nugget made five royal rings.
The gold came from the Clogau St David's mine in North Wales.

That mine closed in nineteen ninety eight.

post.caption: Welsh gold from the Clogau St David's mine in North Wales made the wedding rings of the Queen Mother in 1923, Queen Elizabeth II in 1947, Princess Margaret in 1960, Princess Anne in 1973 and Diana in 1981. Clarence House has said all five came from one nugget. Wartski made Catherine's 2011 ring from Welsh gold the Queen gave William, and reports say less than one gram of the original nugget remains.
